outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially closed (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches the handle and pulls the door outward; separation from the oven body becomes visible around frames 71–82 (image and left_ego_image). The door remains visibly angled open through frame 163 (image), with the displaced handle also visible in wrist_image. No failed acquisition, harmful collision, or displacement of unrelated tabletop objects is established.
